summary.name: Low-Poly 3D (Digital and 3D Aesthetics; explicit provenance).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: a deliberately limited mesh with readable silhouettes, faceted shading, and selected color fields. Joints and contact relationships must stay credible. Camera framing is clear and 3D motion stable. Polygon reduction must not make the subject unrecognizable.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: faceted characters and objects with clear silhouettes; miniature stages (with style-079); terrain and spatial data explainers (with style-097). Inferred: product or explainer scenes needing a stylized 3D look. Travel and game-world teasers are listed as best-for uses in the hybrids.
summary.limitations: Explicit: avoid smoothing normals, mixed realistic textures, and polygon reduction that obscures the subject. Terrain exaggeration must be stated on screen, decorative facets must not change data values, and too many categories should be avoided. Unspecified: any minimum or maximum polygon count.
summary.palette: Suggested, not canonical; used only when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #F1EBDF, foreground #34484C, accent_1 #799C8C, accent_2 #C28A68. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 8.124:1, meeting normal text. Accents are decorative only (3.191 and 3.274 fail 4.5:1). Supplied exact colors override these.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Style-level motion is only described as stable 3D motion with credible contact. Explicit pattern references: gaze tracking (motion-006, needs eye layers or rig); miniature parallax (motion-009, needs layers or 3D); full stationary-subject orbit (motion-010, needs complete geometry or turntable views); chaptered transition (motion-012); storytelling (motion-015); dolly (motion-019) and camera orbit (motion-021), both requiring real 3D depth. Video uses composition time; live pointer or scroll input is interactive-only. Reduced-motion static views are required where interaction is used.
summary.audio: Unspecified by this style; the source leaves audio task-specific. Options to propose from topic, audience, and objective include background music, voiceover, sound effects, ambience, or silence. Honor explicit user audio choices and supplied assets. No genre, tempo, or mandatory layer is assigned. Verify speech clarity, balance, no clipping, and picture sync.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit: faceted meshes and flat shading built in Blender or supplied as geometry, with materials, lighting, and camera settings. Explicit for gaze: bounded eye layers or a rig. Explicit for orbit: complete geometry or sufficient turntable views. Explicit for terrain: verified elevation data. Inferred: local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Source artwork is not recolored.
summary.combinations: Low-Poly 3D alone suits faceted characters and objects. Hybrid style-079 (miniature stage) uses an elevated oblique camera, flat shading only, consistent facet density, and depth of field that never hides the subject; avoid smoothed normals. Hybrid style-097 (terrain) states vertical exaggeration, keeps sage and clay at fixed meanings, places labels in a 2D layer, and uses focusable regions in HTML.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit: Blender, via Python bpy in background mode, acts as style renderer and motion engine using EEVEE or Cycles. HyperFrames is the default for composition, seekable timing, validation (check, snapshot), and export; Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, with the reason recorded. chroma.js validates colors; Delaunator is optional for 2D triangulation. Delivery requires inspecting decoded frames and audio sync.
